title: Defining and Detecting Vulnerability in Human Evaluation Guidelines: A Preliminary Study Towards Reliable NLG Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on detecting general vulnerabilities (e.g., ambiguity, bias, ethical issues like privacy) in human evaluation guidelines for NLG systems.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
